title: Precision tuning of ABA signaling by ubiquitination of ABA receptors: modulating protein activity and localization
content: Ubiquitination of abscisic acid receptors, mediated by distinct E3 ligases, regulates their stability, localization, and activity, revealing complex post-translational control of abscisic acid signaling in plant stress responses and development.
siteTitle: Journal of Experimental Botany Current Issue
